sections.title: Your privacy is a trust
sections.content: We collect only what we need to carry out your order, show the right price for your country and stay in touch with you, and we never sell your data. This policy applies to manasik.net and the Manasik app and WhatsApp.

sections.title: What we collect and why
sections.content: Name, phone, email and country: to create your account, carry out your order and contact you. Names of the people the work is done for and booking details: to carry out and document your order. Payment details and transfer receipts: to complete and review payment; card details are handled by the payment gateway and we do not keep them. Your country from your internet address, SIM and time zone, and your location when needed and with your permission: to show the right price; we store the country name only, never your precise location. Your device's notification ID: for order and offer notifications, which you can turn off in settings. Your chats with Mr. Kabsh: to answer your questions and improve the answers. Usage data, cookies and a random visitor ID: to measure ads and improve the service.

sections.title: Who we share it with
sections.content: Execution teams: only what is needed to carry out your order (names, intention, specifications). Technical service providers: the payment gateway (EasyKash), website and database hosting, WhatsApp, the AI provider that runs Mr. Kabsh, and the notification service. Advertising platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, Snapchat and OpenAI), to measure our ads: they receive your email and phone one-way hashed, with purchase data; you can refuse ad cookies in your browser or device settings. Authorities: only under a binding legal request.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.content: We keep order records for 5 years for accounting and to follow up on any enquiry, and the rest of your data for as long as your account exists.

sections.title: Deleting your account
sections.content: You can delete your account in the app (Account → Delete account) or at manasik.net/en/delete-account; we delete its data within 30 days, except the order records we must keep, which we separate from your identity as far as possible.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.content: You may access, correct and delete your data, and withdraw consent to notifications, location and ad cookies at any time. Email us at manasiksales@gmail.com and we reply within 30 days.

sections.title: Documentation
sections.content: We never publish documentation showing your name or the names of those the work is done for without your explicit consent.

sections.title: Children
sections.content: Our services are for people over 18, and we do not knowingly collect children's data. Newborns' names for aqiqah are provided by a parent or guardian.

sections.title: Data protection
sections.content: Your data is encrypted in transit and only authorised staff can access it. It may be stored on servers outside your country with providers committed to data-protection standards.

sections.title: Updates
sections.content: We will tell you about any significant change in the app or on WhatsApp.

consent.title: Cookie consent
consent.message: We use cookies to measure advertising and analytics, so we can improve our services and show you relevant offers. You can accept all or reject non-essential cookies.

sections.title: About us
sections.content: Manasik is a commercial store that sells livestock and the service of carrying out the sacrifice, at a published price. You choose your product at a clear price and we take care of everything for you: choosing the animal, the slaughter and the distribution, then we send you the documentation so you can see your order was done as you wished. We currently operate in Malawi, Tanzania, Niger and Makkah.

sections.title: How we deal with you
sections.content: What we offer is a paid commercial service: you buy a product or service from a store at a published price; you are not donating to a charity, which is why we do not issue donation receipts or tax-exemption certificates. When you order, you buy what you chose and appoint us to carry it out on your behalf or on behalf of the person you name. The intention is yours, whether aqiqah, a vow or sadaqah, and we carry out what you chose as you specified.

sections.title: How we carry out your order
sections.content: We buy livestock directly from sources we know and choose animals that are healthy and meet the Islamic conditions and the product's specifications. We carry out the work with field teams and specialised partners we choose and follow step by step, and we remain responsible to you for the work matching what you bought. Umrah on behalf and water services in Makkah are carried out by our partners, licensed providers in Saudi Arabia, while we handle the booking, follow-up and documentation.

sections.title: Products and prices
sections.content: Each product page shows its specifications and price before you buy. The price includes carrying out the work and the documentation, with no hidden fees, unless the page says otherwise. Prices are shown in your country's currency and may change from time to time with market and exchange rates; the price you commit to is the one shown when you pay. In share-based projects (such as wells and mosques) you buy a share at a set price in a project we carry out, and work starts once all shares are taken.

sections.title: Order confirmation
sections.content: Your order is confirmed once payment is complete (in full, or the first instalment where offered) and you receive the "Booking confirmed" message. To carry out your order accurately, please check the names and intention, and add at least two contact numbers (one of a family member if possible). Each work is carried out for one person, unless the product page says otherwise.

sections.title: Payment
sections.content: You pay through secure, approved online payment gateways, or by transfer with an uploaded receipt that we review. Your card details are handled by the payment gateway directly and we do not keep them. Some products can be paid in two instalments; the rest is due once the first documentation reaches you.

sections.title: Execution and documentation
sections.content: Umrah on behalf is performed only for someone on whose behalf it is valid (deceased or unable). Documentation for aqiqah, vows, sacrifices and Umrah on behalf reaches you within 24 hours of execution, and may take up to 48 hours in peak seasons, busy periods and emergencies. Some products, such as special or large sizes, need extra time to source, so we agree the execution date with you. Wells and water connections take two weeks to two months. We send the documentation on WhatsApp, and in the app where available so you have proof your order was done. If an amount remains on the order, you first receive a 10-second clip viewable once, then the full documentation after the remaining amount is paid.

sections.title: Changes, cancellation and refunds
sections.content: You can change, replace or cancel your order until 01:00 am Cairo time on the day of execution. After that, we will have bought the animal and set it aside for you, so it cannot be cancelled. If you cancel before then, we file the refund request the same day; the amount is returned to the same payment method minus the online payment fees, and reaches you within up to 15 business days depending on your bank. If we are unable to carry out your order for any reason, you may choose another date or a full refund.

sections.title: Your account
sections.content: Keep your sign-in details private. You can delete your account at any time in the app (Account → Delete account) or at manasik.net/en/delete-account. Prices are shown for your country; if it cannot be determined accurately (for example behind a VPN), the international price list applies. Mr. Kabsh is an AI assistant that answers your questions and guides you; we work to keep it accurate, but the product page, these terms and the booking confirmation are always the final reference.

sections.title: Limits of liability
sections.content: We do our best to carry out your order on time. If it is delayed by circumstances beyond our control (such as epidemics, government decisions, unrest or disasters), we tell you right away and agree on a solution with you. We rely on the details you enter in your order, so please review them before paying; we are not responsible for results of incorrect or incomplete details. In all cases our liability does not exceed the amount paid for the order.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.content: The texts, images, designs and the Manasik mark are ours; please do not use them without permission. The website and app may not be used for any unlawful purpose or to abuse offers.

sections.title: Updates to these terms
sections.content: These terms apply to manasik.net and the Manasik app and to orders placed on WhatsApp; completing an order means you accept them. We may update them from time to time, and the version published at the time of your order applies.

sections.title: Contact us
sections.content: We are happy to help: WhatsApp +201027282396 — email manasiksales@gmail.com — website manasik.net
